row.evidence: Microsoft's Paylocity tutorial requires a "Paylocity single sign-on (SSO) enabled subscription" and says "Work with Paylocity support team to add the users in the Paylocity platform"; Paylocity's own Okta and Entra integrations only send employee data from Paylocity into the IdP.
row.notes: New row. No inbound SCIM: Paylocity is the HR system of record, and every identity integration found is outbound (Paylocity -> Okta/Entra ID via HR-sourced provisioning; Okta OIN app checks SCIM Create/Update/Attribute Sourcing but no Deactivate; Aquera connector imports from Paylocity). Rule 3a/3b: scored as a provisioning target, so none. SAML SSO is configured under HR & Payroll > User Access > SSO Configuration and needs an "SSO enabled subscription" (plan not named; pricing is quote-only, so team/SSO plan fields are null). Paylocity also sells an Access Management (IT) product built on OneLogin that provisions employees outward; noted in fallbacks.other_sync, not status. Developer API is approval-gated and employee-centric (OAuth client credentials; beta CoreHR v2 employee endpoints; new-hire, employee-change and termination webhooks). Confidence low: Paylocity's client help centre is login-only.

plans.name: Paylocity HCM (custom package)
plans.notes: No public plan names or prices; SSO requires an "SSO enabled subscription" per Microsoft's tutorial.

scim.notes: Paylocity is the HR system of record. Its Okta and Entra integrations push employee identity data OUT of Paylocity into the IdP (outbound/HR-sourced), and Okta's Aquera connector imports users from Paylocity; none provisions users INTO Paylocity. Microsoft's tutorial says users must be created in Paylocity with Paylocity support before SSO. Rule 3a: scim.available false.

webhooks_user_events.notes: Employee (HR record) webhooks; the termination webhook is suggested for disabling Active Directory users.

limitations.text: API access requires Paylocity approval (existing customer or a sponsoring customer); the CoreHR v2 employee endpoints are beta, early-adopter only.

user_api.notes: Employee (worker) data API for customers and partners, not management of Paylocity login users or roles.

okta.notes: OIN markup checks SAML, SWA, SCIM, Create, Update and Attribute Sourcing (no Deactivate): an HR-sourced import from Paylocity into Okta, not provisioning into Paylocity. Paylocity (Demo) app is the same. Separate "Paylocity User Mastering Connector by Aquera" (third party) also imports users from Paylocity.

entra.notes: Gallery app with SAML SSO tutorial only; users created manually in Paylocity. Paylocity's own Entra integration flows Paylocity -> Entra.

google.notes: Paylocity marketplace lists a Google Workspace integration page (outbound, not loaded in detail).

onelogin.notes: Paylocity's Access Management product is built on OneLogin (outbound provisioning from Paylocity); OneLogin catalogue page not loaded.

fallbacks.other_sync: Outbound: Paylocity pushes employee identity/status to Okta and Entra ID (HR-sourced provisioning), and sells an Access Management add-on built on OneLogin that provisions Paylocity employees into Office 365, Google Workspace and OneLogin-catalogue apps.

open_questions: Which Paylocity package or add-on includes SSO (the "SSO enabled subscription") is not published.
Whether Paylocity supports SAML JIT user creation is not documented (Microsoft's tutorial says users must exist first).
Paylocity help centre is login-only; SCIM absence could not be confirmed there.
What the Okta Paylocity app's Create/Update provisioning writes into Paylocity (if anything) is not documented by Paylocity.
